newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NatSteel, Uraco in tie up.
newsitem.headline: NatSteel, Uraco in tie up.

text.p: NatSteel Ltd said on Friday it had restructured its 54.6 percent subsidiary, Multiwave Innovation Pte Ltd (MWI).

It said in a statement that subsidiary NatSteel Electronics Pte Ltd (NEL) and disk-drive maker Uraco Holdings Ltd would take a 45.45 percent stake each in a recapitalised MWI. Key MWI management staff take the remaining 9.1 percent.

NatSteel said it transferred 416,000 MWI shares to NEL for a nominal consideration. It said Uraco would inject S$5.76 million and NEL has committed to invest S$5.86 million in MWI for the new ordinary shares.
MWI's business focus is the design and development of computer modems to meet demand growth from the internet market. It also designs and markets modem products for personal computers and notebooks.
